name: Ai Yang Cheng 2
source:
A great love simulation, dressup and otome game.

You are a great adventurer destined to meet your lolita and shota. Take care and plan for his/her daily schedules, which range from studying science, poetry, arts, wizardry, and alchemy to adventuring, dating or taking a vacation. You have so many possibilities to raise your child and influence the how the story play out.

An inspiring Japanese love and otome game that allows you to:
- train your child with various schooling activities
- explore all game scenes and collect hundreds of high quality CGs
- multiple storylines and ending adventure
- dressup and customize your prince or princess of dream

Anime Story - Simulated Dating and Otome Game

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230722074328/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cn.catcap.ayc2en&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
一款很棒的恋爱模拟、换装、乙女游戏。

你是一位伟大的冒险家，注定会遇见你的洛丽塔和正太。照顾和计划他/她的日常日程，范围从学习科学、诗歌、艺术、巫术和炼金术到冒险、约会或度假。你有很多可能性来抚养你的孩子并影响故事的发展。

一款鼓舞人心的日本爱情和乙女游戏，让你可以：
- 通过各种学校活动训练你的孩子
- 探索所有游戏场景并收集数百张高品质CG
- 多个故事情节和结局冒险
- 装扮并定制你的梦想王子或公主

动漫物语 - 模拟恋爱乙女游戏
